channel.title: Unintended Consequences Blog
channel.description: Blog posts from Unintended Consequences podcast episodes.

item.title: D.A.R.E. placed uniformed officers in classrooms to teach millions of children to refuse drugs, yet repeated evaluations found the program produced little measurable change in behavior.
